nodes.name: Fe electrodeposition on SS/SSM
nodes.procedure: For the construction of two-electrode system for electrodeposition process, we chose stainless steel substrates (SS or SSM, 1 cm × 4 cm,) to serve as cathode, a piece of SS (1 cm × 4 cm,) was set as anode, and the composition of electrolyte was 0.1 M FeCl2 solution. For the detailed electrodeposition process, the distance between cathode and anode was set as 1.6 cm, and the deposition current and deposition time were set as 0.2 A and 2 min, respectively. After the electrodeposition process, the cathode was taken out from the electrolyte and cleaned using deionized water, denoted as Fe/SS or Fe/SSM.
nodes.source_text: Methods section: Synthesis of ACCE and 3D-ACCE... deposition current and deposition time were set as 0.2 A and 2 min

nodes.name: Sacrificial corrosion NiFe-LDH growth
nodes.procedure: As for the modified corrosion reaction, the 10 mL of 0.1 M NiSO4 solution was first added into a 12 mL glass bottle to serve as corrosion solution, then the Fe/SS or Fe/SSM was immersed into the solution at 80 °C for 3 h. After the reaction, the as-obtained electrode was washed with deionized water and placed in a vacuum drying oven at 60 °C for 12 h, denoted as ACCE (from Fe/SS) or 3D-ACCE (from Fe/SSM).

nodes.name: Hydrothermal NiFe-LDH
nodes.procedure: A mixture of 0.247 g of Ni(NO3)2·6H2O, 0.15 g of urea, 0.0463 g of NH4F, and 0.09 g of Fe(NO3)3·9H2O was added to 15 mL of deionized water and stirred magnetically for 15 minutes. The mixed solution, along with a cleaned stainless steel sheet (SS), was then placed in a 25 mL Teflon-lined autoclave and subjected to hydrothermal treatment at 120 °C for 8 hours. After cooling, the SS with the hydrothermally grown NiFe-LDH film was obtained and denoted as NiFe-LDH-H.
nodes.source_text: Methods section: Synthesis of NiFe-LDH-H... hydrothermal treatment at 120 °C for 8 hours

nodes.name: Traditional corrosion on Fe foam
nodes.procedure: A 1 cm × 4 cm piece of Fe foam was ultrasonically cleaned in 1 M oxalic acid, ethanol, and deionized water for 5 minutes each to remove surface oxides. It was then transferred to a 0.1 M NiSO4 solution for 12 hours. Afterward, it was rinsed with deionized water and dried, denoted as NiFe-LDH-C/FF.

nodes.procedure: Before performance testing, all electrodes were activated by cyclic voltammetry (CV) for ten cycles within a potential range of 0.924-1.924 V vs. RHE at a scan rate of 100 mV/s. The activated ACCE and 3D-ACCE electrode were denoted as ACCE-a and 3D-ACCE-a, respectively.
